rows.operation: Deaths during or following police contact: 2025/26 release metadata exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: The confirmed release metadata identifies scope and reporting period but does not itself provide case-level findings or establish risk at a police force, address, person or parcel.

rows.operation: Safety in custody: quarterly update to March 2026 release metadata exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Release metadata describes prison-custody deaths, self-harm and assaults at England-and-Wales level; it is not evidence of conditions at a particular prison wing, person, address or parcel.

rows.operation: Safety in the Children and Young People Secure Estate: update to March 2026 release metadata exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Release metadata covers assaults, self-harm, separations, use of force and deaths in the secure estate; it cannot be converted into a child-level, institution-level or parcel-level prediction.

rows.operation: Youth custody data: May 2026 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Custody population breakdowns are establishment, demographic and regional statistics; they do not establish individual risk or exact safety conditions at a facility or parcel.

rows.operation: Prison population monthly figures: June 2026 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Population totals describe prison-estate capacity context and cannot be used as a direct proxy for violence, safety, local crime or parcel risk.

rows.operation: Police use of firearms statistics, April 2025 to March 2026 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: National and police-force-area firearms-operation statistics do not establish threat, response likelihood or safety at a specific incident, address or parcel.

rows.operation: Firearm and shotgun certificates, April 2025 to March 2026 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Certificate counts and holder characteristics are licensing statistics and must not be treated as evidence of firearm presence, misuse or risk at a household or parcel.

rows.operation: Operation of police powers under TACT 2000, to March 2026 exact-parcel attribution boundary was audited
rows.evidence: Arrest, outcome and stop-and-search statistics under terrorism legislation are aggregate legal-process data and do not predict a terrorist incident, person, building or parcel.
